haystack_sessions.content: I want to make a vegetarian lasagna for six people this weekend. Any tips on layering?
For six people, use a 9x13 pan and three layers of pasta. Salt the zucchini first so the lasagna is not watery, and rest it ten minutes before serving.
My dog Biscuit is a three-year-old golden retriever and she loves swimming at the lake.
Golden retrievers are usually strong swimmers. After lake days, rinse Biscuit's coat and dry her ears well to avoid infections.
Good idea. She shakes water everywhere, so I keep towels by the door now.
I am planning a trip to Lisbon in September. Is that a good month to visit?
September is a great month for Lisbon: the summer crowds thin out, the ocean is still warm, and average highs are around 26 degrees Celsius.

haystack_sessions.content: I started taking guitar lessons last month and my fingertips are so sore after practice.
Sore fingertips are normal in the first weeks of guitar lessons. Keep sessions short and daily, and calluses will form within about a month.
My guitar teacher wants me to learn barre chords next. Any practice advice for music beginners?
For barre chords, place your index finger close to the fret and practice the F major shape a few minutes each lesson rather than in one long session.
